verdict.rationale: The plugins docs show `ultrametric init --dry-run --json` previewing changes before a second command 'writes the selected skill files', and the CLI can add instructions for Codex and Claude Code. This implies some selection at install time, but it is unclear whether a developer can pick individual skills from the collection or only choose the target agent host. missing for 10: explicit documentation of choosing individual skills from a catalog, a list of the available skills, per-skill install/uninstall commands, and independent or hands-on confirmation of selective install. [2026-10-14 adversarial bias audit (owner-product refresh lane): quality 4 -> 3 — the +1 rests on docs-30, which documents choosing the target agent host, not choosing skills, and the rationale concedes it is unclear whether individual skills can be picked at all. anthropic-skills' partial 5 stands on a real per-skill API selection surface; the owner's "implies some selection" reading stays at the pre-refresh 3. Ultrametric-affiliation governance, README §9.]
